about_the_game:
🏆 Success

Climb from zero to the top of success!

Work, study, start businesses, invest, and compete with others to build your dream life in a unique clicker game about the real world.

Success: is a desktop incremental game where every click brings you closer to your next goal.

Start from nothing — get your first job, open your first business, invest in stocks and bonds, and manage your time and resources to achieve true financial freedom.

🔑 Game features:

🏢 Work — earn money by working multiple jobs at once. Manage your energy and plan your day efficiently.

💻 Freelance — work on flexible projects, earn extra income, and build your independent career.

💼 Business — invest in startups, upgrade your ventures, and watch your profit grow — or lose part of your investment if the market turns against you.

🌐 Illegal Business — take the dark path to wealth. Build an illegal empire, but beware of the risks and consequences.

💰 Money Laundering — convert your dirty money into clean assets through sophisticated laundering operations.

🔫 Crimes — commit crimes for quick cash, but remember: the higher the reward, the greater the risk of getting caught.

📚 Education — take courses, develop new skills, and unlock advanced professions and opportunities.

📈 Stocks — trade on the stock market, analyze trends, and build your portfolio with dynamic price charts.

💎 Crypto Mining — set up mining rigs, mine cryptocurrencies, and watch real-time price charts to maximize your profits.

🏛️ Bonds — buy government bonds with different yields and maturities to secure long-term passive income.

🏘️ Real Estate — invest in properties, collect rental income, and build a real estate empire for steady cash flow.

⛏️ Land Mining — purchase land plots, extract valuable resources, and upgrade your equipment to increase mining efficiency.

🏦 Bank — take loans or make deposits. Manage your assets like a true financial strategist.

🛋️ Property — buy items and assets that restore energy and improve your quality of life.

🎲 Lottery — take a risk and try your luck with tickets of different rarity and chances to win big!

⚡ Energy & Health — balance between studying, working, resting, and entertainment to stay productive.

🛌 Rest — recover your energy and health through various relaxation activities to maintain peak performance.

💊 Habits — develop positive habits that boost your stats and unlock new opportunities over time.

🤖 Competition — grow your wealth and compete with virtual players who also build their fortunes. Can you become the richest among them?

🚀 The Path to Success — from a broke dreamer to a millionaire investor and business magnate.

👥 Who is this game for?

✅ Fans of clickers and incremental games who enjoy steady progress and smart management.

✅ Players who love economy, investment, and life simulation mechanics.

✅ Those who want to relax but still feel a sense of growth and accomplishment.

✅ Anyone who believes that success is built one step — or one click — at a time.
